source.title: Weaviate REST API

authentication.admitted: Weaviate Cloud or secured self-hosted deployment using Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>; the connection stores the complete header value.
authentication.swagger_security: The pinned Swagger declares optional OIDC because deployments are configurable; the pack deliberately requires a secured generic connection.

source.documentary_posture: Every generated leaf points directly at the immutable raw Swagger document from the pinned official Weaviate repository commit. A wire_prefix proof alias removes /v1 because Swagger 2.0 carries that segment in basePath rather than in each path key. The root carries dependencies rather than a second composition.

exclusions.GET /mcp: The endpoint opens a long-lived text/event-stream MCP transport, not a finite JSON REST response. Use a protocol-aware MCP connection rather than pretending this is an ordinary static REST call.
exclusions.POST /mcp: The endpoint is MCP Streamable HTTP/JSON-RPC, but the Swagger operation declares no request-body or session-header contract that a static REST binding can prove. Use a protocol-aware MCP connection rather than pretending this is an ordinary static REST call.
exclusions.DELETE /mcp: The endpoint terminates an MCP session, but the Swagger operation declares no session identifier or header contract that a static REST binding can prove. Use a protocol-aware MCP connection rather than pretending this is an ordinary static REST call.
exclusions.HEAD /objects/{className}/{id}: The REST composition method set does not admit HEAD; the same documented resource has a selected GET operation, so no feature family is lost.
exclusions.HEAD /objects/{id}: The REST composition method set does not admit HEAD; the same documented resource has a selected GET operation, so no feature family is lost.
exclusions.HEAD /schema/{className}/tenants/{tenant: The REST composition method set does not admit HEAD; the same documented resource has a selected GET operation, so no feature family is lost.

contract_gaps.mcp_protocol: GET /mcp is a long-lived SSE transport, POST /mcp is MCP Streamable HTTP/JSON-RPC without a documentary body/session contract, and DELETE /mcp lacks its session identifier in Swagger. All three require a protocol-aware MCP connection and are excluded from static REST.
contract_gaps.head_aliases: Three HEAD existence checks are excluded because the composition REST method set does not admit HEAD. Each exact resource has a selected GET companion, so object and tenant reads remain available.
contract_gaps.object_pagination: GET /objects documents mutually incompatible offset and UUID-after modes; after also conflicts with sort. The operation exposes after, offset, limit, and sort explicitly and does not claim an automatic paginator that would silently choose or combine modes.
contract_gaps.exact_request_integers: Every admitted JSON body is sent as literal body_raw, and every scalar query integer is emitted from an exact decimal-string argument. Neither route converts the value through JavaScript Number.
contract_gaps.exact_response_integers: Every admitted application/json response uses unsafe_integers=string so int64 timestamps, totals, task IDs, and other large integer literals remain exact.
contract_gaps.csv_query_array: Swagger 2.0 defaults the optional tenants array query parameter to CSV serialization. The operation exposes one comma-separated string so the REST adapter does not incorrectly repeat the parameter.
contract_gaps.dynamic_origin: Weaviate Cloud cluster URLs and self-hosted origins vary. The connection is per-org and uses an HTTPS placeholder solely as an enrollment example.
contract_gaps.configurable_authentication: The server supports configurable authentication. The generated pack chooses the documented Authorization Bearer API-key form and does not weaken the connection to anonymous access.
contract_gaps.arbitrary_records: Weaviate collections and objects have user-defined schemas and arbitrary properties. No task, note, or project Source is declared without live canonical field-path and sync-semantics proof.
contract_gaps.credential_responses: Database-user creation and key rotation can return a new API key. Those admin/destructive operations always require approval, their descriptions keep the sensitive response explicit, and no bundled workflow invokes them.

source_eligibility.evidence: A Weaviate collection is a user-defined vector index, not a canonical project entity, and the suite has no live project field-path proof.
Object properties are arbitrary per collection; the pack does not infer task semantics from user-defined keys.
Object properties and vectors do not establish canonical note fields, versions, or list/read sync semantics.
